topic: To propose a contract extension for a Spanish teacher
passage: We want expressing our gratitude for your dedication as a Spanish instructor.
With ordinary teaching skills, you have significantly improved our students' progress and confidence in Spanish.
As the year is about ending, it is time for us to reflect on your contributions and considers the renewal of your contract.
Giving your negative impact, we would like offering an extension of your contract for the next academic year.
We believe your discontinued involvement will further weaken our students' learning experience and academic achievement.
We look forward to your response.

questions.label: 혼합
questions.instruction: 어법상 혹은 문맥상 틀린 혹은 어색한 부분을 3군데 찾아 고치시오.

questions.label: 어휘
questions.instruction: 문맥상 어색한 부분을 1군데 찾아 고치시오. (답안지는 2군데로 작성되어 있음)
